summary: Evil Genius lair-building strategy entries, preserving the original Windows classic and the modern sequel's PC-first content route.

entries.title: Evil Genius

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows release with compatibility fixes if needed.

primary.why: Evil Genius is a Windows-only lair-building strategy/simulation classic from Elixir Studios, now published digitally by Rebellion. The release date is September 28, 2004, with a current Windows PC storefront route. No console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass, so Windows PC is the archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC digital release, applying compatibility settings if needed on modern Windows. Treat Evil Genius 2 as a separate sequel.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive edition split was found. Evil Genius 2 is a separate sequel, not a replacement for the original.

entries.title: Evil Genius 2: World Domination
entries.definitive_edition: Evil Genius 2: World Domination Deluxe Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Deluxe Edition or current PC release with DLC
primary.why: Evil Genius 2 launched first on Windows PC in March 2021 and later came to PlayStation and Xbox in November 2021. Steam exposes the clearest current content route, including Deluxe Edition/DLC content and the best settings/capture control. No sourced console-exclusive gameplay content was found in this pass, so Windows PC is the preferred archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release through Steam, ideally with Deluxe Edition or equivalent owned DLC if documenting the complete current content set. Use console versions only for couch/platform comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Sequel to Evil Genius, not DLC or a remaster of the 2004 game. DLC packs should be included if documenting the complete current content route.
